title: Feed the reporter's done_item and demonstrating_check into the absorption decision, or stop promising it
body: nfo carries done_item and demonstrating_check onto the draft, and the worker prompts now say the run runs the named check and scores the claim. decideFinding passes only id, title and body to the oracle and predictor, and nothing scores the reporter's claim. Either give the classifier the claim as evidence and score it, or correct the prompt text in profiles*/closeout-epic.md, implement-tick.md and review-epic.md.
